author: bg997965
name: smoke-ring-cloud-shader
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Smoke Ring style. Cloud variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#6A5AE0, #102A43, #05070F, #F3C4FB). Features: cursor-reactive (push), high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
